narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch satirizing workplace dynamics, specifically highlighting the contradiction between a boss's verbal support for employee well-being and the actual pressure exerted when an employee tries to take leave. It aims to entertain by being highly relatable to working professionals.
